# Financial Ratios for BKNG Fiscal 2017

## Figures

- **Booking Holdings Inc. 2016**: 236.31 (Source: documents/report.md)
- **NASDAQ Composite Index 2016**: 187.19 (Source: documents/report.md)
- **S&P 500 Index 2013**: 132.39 (Source: documents/report.md)
- **Booking Holdings Inc. 2014**: 183.79 (Source: documents/report.md)

## Ratio Calculation

At the measurement point December 31, 2016, the ratio of Booking Holdings Inc. to the NASDAQ Composite Index is:

\[ \text{Ratio} = \frac{\text{Booking Holdings Inc. 2016}}{\text{NASDAQ Composite Index 2016}} = \frac{236.31}{187.19} \approx 1.26 \]

**Source:** documents/report.md

**Note:** All figures are final and audited.
